reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app to finish the ridiculous revenge stories they tease on TikTok, only to lock all the satisfying reveals behind a paywall. Why are you charging people this much for AI-generated stories when creating them is becoming increasingly cheap and accessible? All you need is a video generator, a prompt, and some editing.

I finally finished Your Puppy Sister Was Never Coming Back, and even the ending was disappointing. The brothers spend their time regretting everything while the sister basically goes, “Oh well, guess I’ll move on to my next life.” HELLO??? 

I genuinely regret wasting even six dollars on this app. Save your money and look for REAL revenge stories from REAL creators who put actual creativity and effort into their work and deliver the satisfying endings these apps promise but fail to provide.

For people who wrote the stories I get needing to make money- but all this is AI and shouldn't cost the amount of someone's time and talent.

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.text:
Honestly, BlinkDrama was really good at first, but now it feels like every story is the same. The only things that change are the characters, names, or whether they’re people or animals, but the plots and endings are always repetitive. There’s barely anything new or original anymore.

I’m paying for this app, but honestly, it’s starting to feel like a waste of money when every new story that comes out feels like a copy of the previous ones. It’s making me want to switch to another app because I originally downloaded BlinkDrama after seeing an interesting story on Instagram, but now the stories I find on Instagram are way more interesting than the ones available on BlinkDrama.

I even try searching for those stories on BlinkDrama because I want to watch them, but they’re either not available or the stories on the app have completely different plots. For example, I wanted to watch Silver Blood: The True Heiress Returns, but of course, it wasn’t available.

All I’m asking is for BlinkDrama to bring in more original stories, fresh plots, and different endings instead of constantly recycling the same storylines with different characters. New and creative stories are seriously needed. I want to keep using the app, but if the content continues to be this repetitive, I honestly don’t see the point in continuing to pay for it.

reviews.title: Lame stories, terrible AI dialogue
reviews.text: I signed up, wanting to finish the end of one story I had found via TikTok - I got through the end of the story and every other single title in the catalogue is tacky and repetitive. Half the stories the accent on the characters flips back and forth from English to American to who knows what. Closed captioning gets so much spelling wrong. If there’s any kind of unique words, half the time the characters pronounce it incorrectly. It just feels like it’s really rushed and shoddy. Don’t bother, there’s better stuff on YouTube. Or go to the library and read.

reviews.title: Don’t waste time/money

reviews.title: No way to cancel
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and searched everywhere for a way to cancel a subscription but there is no option. So before I subscribed to anything, I immediately deleted it. If this app wants to get anywhere, there needs to be a place to cancel the subscription within the app. All the ads I see for these short dramas look really good but if I can’t cancel the subscription with the push of a button when I choose to, I’m not getting. I already had to cancel and replace several credit cards because of this and I won’t do it again.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I’ve seen other reviews about not being able to cancel. You absolutely can cancel. However, none of the stories are complete. I have watched several great ones, but then am disappointed because not a single one is complete. I don’t recommend this app.

reviews.title: $30 a week for AI Slop
reviews.text: Honestly this is all AI generated and it’s so obvious when they say a name “morretti” 10 different ways and the injuries are there then disappear 3 seconds later. They say $30 is to produce high quality stories when they pump out nonsense. Save your money and support actual content!

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: I see ads for these kinds of apps all the time. “No unlock required” they say or something along the same line. But as soon as you download the apps you have to pay for a subscription or watch ads to unlock barely anything. Either be true to what you put in your ads or take it out of the ads.

reviews.title: Upset
reviews.text: I can’t say the dramas were all bad because they weren’t but I am very disappointed due to the fact that even after continuously trying to cancel my subscription they continue to charge my account after weeks of me emailing and contacting them. I had to cancel and get a new bank card and somehow they are still attempting to charge me everyday. It’s so upsetting to have to deal through this

reviews.title: Scam, cannot cancel subscription
reviews.text: There is no way to cancel the subscription. They state on their app to go through settings on Apple, but it’s not linked Apple. In responses to other reviews they state you need to open the blink drama app go to your profile, open settings and click manage subscription. Only issue with that is that the option does not exist! I speak both Spanish and English their directions are useless. Do not give them your money.

reviews.title: No cancellation option!
reviews.text: They give you guide how to cancel on the app however the purchase or subscriptions does not even show on Apple Subscriptions nor it shows on the actual BlinkDrama app! You click profile and there is no “Manage Membership” option. Apps that doesn’t have membership management option on at the actual app should be banned! This trick will cause people to not be able to cancel immediately before renewal and then on their description “No refund once the renewal is successful”. How inconvenient for subscribers and how so convenient for App owner making those money just cause “WE CAN’T CANCEL SUBSCRIPTIONS WITHOUT EMAILING CUSTOMER SERVICE!”

reviews.title: Unable to Cancel Subscription
reviews.text: “I do not recommend this app. I was charged for a subscription, but there is no option to cancel it in the app. Customer support has not responded to my emails, and the subscription does not appear in my Apple subscriptions either. I updated the app as instructed, but ‘Manage Membership’ is still missing. This has been a very frustrating experience.”
